newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint closes up vs dlr, steady vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint closes up vs dlr, steady vs basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed steady against the currency basket on Monday and firmer against the dollar, helped by the mark's gains against the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The forint finished at 155.50/55 to one dollar, up from its opening of 155.63/68.
"That happened because there was a little movement in the dollar/mark, but not much," said Andras Szekely of Magyar Hitel Bank.
The forint remained some 13 fillers weaker than the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) resistance level (bid).
